SCENE 01 — SLOW SUNDAY

MUCENT is a street-casual label from Seoul. The name joins "Mu" (武, a warrior) with "Cent," taken from Van Gogh, Central Park and centripetal — and the M at its center stands for taking on the world. The brand is known for a black-first, monochrome wardrobe and its logo ball cap.

The Ruffin Half T is where that edge loosens up: a camo body, plain raglan sleeves, a slim semi-crop fit in 100% cotton, and the script M across the chest.

Six people, six days, one tee — a bakery run, a market street, a sunny drive, a night out in Siam.
